transcript.text: Hi everyone, before I finalize and sign off on Aria Vale's remote appearance package for the festival's closing stream, I need to check in with both the broadcast engineer and the rights manager. Are there any production requirements or clearance issues I should know about? I want to make sure we have everything covered before I send the final specs to production.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Maya, I need to flag a critical production issue. My post-rehearsal network test showed that the venue cannot maintain reliable two-way latency for a live performance. However, it can reliably play an artist-approved pre-recorded file — but that file must be exactly 7 minutes or shorter, delivered as 1080p SDR with stereo audio. I completed this test after the last production meeting and haven't entered the result in the production log yet. This directly conflicts with the currently planned live 20-minute segment, so we'll need to adjust the package.

transcript.text: Maya, I have a critical clearance issue to flag. I received written distributor confirmation this morning while the clearance file was being updated. Aria Vale's appearance is only permitted in the United States and Canada — the stream must be geoblocked everywhere else. Additionally, the on-screen credit must read exactly 'Aria Vale — Closing Performance.' This means the worldwide stream as currently planned cannot proceed without geoblocking, and the credit specification needs to be added to the package.
